Every button gets hover/focus/active/disabled states, every card gets hover effects, every input gets focus rings. Adds professional polish elements: hover:scale-[1.02], active:scale-[0.98], backdrop-blur effects, smooth transitions (150-300ms), ARIA labels, and WCAG compliance. Post-generation enhancement that transforms basic components into production-quality UI matching Linear/Stripe standards.

in_progress_features.name: Design Token Injection System
in_progress_features.description: CRITICAL MISSING PIECE (NOW FIXED): Generates tailwind.config.ts with design system tokens from DesignIntelligence. Injects custom colors (primary, background, foreground, surface, border, ring, etc.) as Tailwind theme extensions so components can use classes like bg-background, text-foreground, border-border. Converts design spec JSON to Tailwind config, writes config file to build directory, ensures hot reload picks up changes. Also generates CSS variables for design tokens and injects into globals.css. Integrated into build orchestrator and runs automatically after design system generation.

in_progress_features.name: Intelligent Multi-Dimensional Design Profiling
in_progress_features.description: Revolutionary design intelligence that goes beyond simple industry detection. Analyzes apps across 6 dimensions (WHAT: purpose, WHO: audience, HOW: usage pattern, FEEL: emotional tone, WHERE: industry, STYLE: visual language) to create contextual, purposeful designs. Uses Claude Sonnet 4 for deep analysis, finds 3-5 reference apps that match THE FEEL (not just industry), and builds dynamic design profiles instead of static templates. Learns from user modifications and continuously improves. Can detect entirely new app types automatically.

in_progress_features.name: Vector Embeddings & Similarity Search
in_progress_features.description: Vector database integration for finding similar design profiles based on app descriptions. Creates embeddings of PRD text using OpenAI embeddings API, stores in vector database (Pinecone or Supabase pgvector), and performs semantic similarity search. When detecting a new app, checks if similar profiles exist (confidence > 0.85) before running expensive Claude analysis. Enables profile reuse and faster design generation.
